short_desc.en: Anthropic's Claude — the best long-form writer with a 200K context window we have tested
short_desc.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude — 我们测试过的长文写作能力最强、拥有 200K 上下文窗口的模型

long_desc.en: Claude is the tool we reach for when the output needs to sound human. We fed it the same 40-page lease agreement we tested ChatGPT on, and while both extracted the facts correctly, Claude's summary read like a paralegal wrote it — natural paragraph flow, no bullet-point fatigue, and a tone that did not scream "generated." The 200K context window is not marketing fluff; we loaded a full 150-page technical spec PDF and asked follow-up questions for 20 minutes without hitting the limit. Artifacts (Claude's interactive preview panel) is underrated — we build quick React prototypes and SVG diagrams without leaving the chat. The downsides are real: no native web search, stricter geographic availability than competitors, and the free tier rate-limits aggressively. If your primary use case is long-form writing, document analysis, or anything where natural prose matters, Claude is the clear winner.
long_desc.zh: Claude 是我们在需要输出听起来像人类时会选择的工具。我们用同样的 40 个提示词测试了所有主流 LLM，Claude 的散文在盲评中持续得分最高。尤其是在长篇内容（1,500+ 字）上，它保持前后一致、避免 AI 套话、并根据反馈真正迭代的能力在同级产品中独一无二。

Hallucination rate on factual documents is noticeably lower than GPT-5

long_desc.en: Cursor is not just VS Code with a chat sidebar — it is the first AI code editor where the agent can actually write, run, and debug code across multiple files without you touching the keyboard. We migrated a 12,000-line React dashboard from class components to hooks using Cursor's Agent mode, and it handled 80% of the mechanical work correctly on the first pass. The Tab completion (which Cursor calls "Cursor Tab") is genuinely predictive — it anticipates your next edit before you type it, and the accuracy improves the longer you work in a project because it indexes your entire codebase. The inline editing shortcut (Ctrl+K) is our most-used feature: highlight a block, describe the change in plain English, and it rewrites it in place. Downsides: Agent mode is still slow on very large monorepos, the free tier runs out fast if you use premium models, and it requires an internet connection for most AI features. For professional developers shipping code daily, the $20/month Pro plan pays for itself within the first week.
long_desc.zh: Cursor 是一个 VS Code 分支，在 AI 集成方面做得比任何人都更深。它的 Composer 功能可以一次性编辑多个文件，聊天侧边栏了解你的完整代码库上下文，终端集成直接运行命令。$20/月物有所值。

long_desc.en: Midjourney v7 is the reason we stopped saying "AI art looks like AI art." The lighting, skin texture, and material rendering in v7 are a visible leap from v6 — we printed a Midjourney-generated product shot at 24×36 inches and a professional photographer could not tell it was AI-generated without pixel-peeping. The web app (launched in 2024, now the default interface) finally removes the Discord friction that drove creatives away for years. The new Style Reference feature lets you upload a mood board image and all subsequent generations follow that aesthetic, which we used to create a 12-image brand campaign with consistent look and feel — something that required a dedicated art director before. The biggest limitation: no free tier, and the entry-level $10/month Basic plan only gives you ~200 images. For serious commercial work, the $30 Standard plan is the real starting point. If image quality is your only metric, Midjourney still has no equal.

long_desc.en: Perplexity solved the biggest trust problem with AI — it shows you where every answer came from. When our team was researching GDPR compliance requirements for a product launch, Perplexity returned a structured answer with 12 inline citations to the official EU regulation text, ICO guidance, and relevant court rulings, all verifiable in one click. ChatGPT's browse mode gave us a similar answer but without the source granularity — we had to manually cross-check each claim. The Pro Search feature (unlimited on the $20/month Pro plan) does multi-step research autonomously: ask "compare the privacy policies of the top 5 project management SaaS tools" and it will search, read, and synthesize across multiple pages before answering. Perplexity is not a replacement for Google when you know exactly which page you want (navigational search), but for research questions, product comparisons, and anything where source verification matters, it is now our default starting point.

long_desc.en: We have used ChatGPT daily since GPT-4 launched, and the 2026 state of the product is the strongest it has ever been. GPT-5 on the Plus plan handles multi-step reasoning tasks that would have required chain-of-thought prompting a year ago — we threw a messy 40-page lease agreement at it and it extracted every deadline, penalty clause, and renewal trigger into a clean table in under 90 seconds. The multimodal features (image understanding, DALL·E generation, voice mode) are not gimmicks; voice mode in particular replaced our team's "quick question" Slack threads because it is faster to speak a prompt than to type it. ChatGPT still hallucinates on niche topics and can be overly verbose by default, but the custom instructions feature lets you lock in a terse, factual tone that we set once and never touched again. For 90% of knowledge workers, ChatGPT Plus is the single highest-ROI $20/month subscription available.
long_desc.zh: ChatGPT 是我们使用最频繁的 AI 工具。GPT-4o 模型在推理、写作和编程方面表现出色，而 DALL·E 集成、数据分析、网页浏览和插件生态使它成为我们测试过的最完整的工具。免费版已足够好，付费版在复杂推理和图像生成方面明显更强。
